name: The Doctor Is In!: Loa's Brew can target Lil Wa'zoo and credits the quest (COA-9957)
contract: Issues #9957, #10283: The Doctor Is In! 200027 asks the witch doctor to heal Lil Wa'zoo 85031 in Echo Ridge Mine with Loa's Brew. Lil Wa'zoo lacked CREATURE_TYPE_FLAG_CAN_ASSIST, which the troll patient Hi'bi Ja'min 9300203 has, so the server refused him as a heal target and the client healed the player instead. The fixture stands beside his spawn in clear line of sight. Expected: a self cast works as the control, and a cast on Lil Wa'zoo is sent and credits Save Lil Wa'zoo.

steps.label: SETUP: p is on The Doctor Is In!
CONTROL: the self cast is sent
DISCRIMINATING: the cast on Lil Wa'zoo is sent
